summary.tldr: Updates criminal court and police procedures to allow more remote hearings, electronic jury selection, and new telewarrant rules.
what_it_does: Allows electronic or other automated tools to be used in jury selection.
Expands when accused people and offenders can appear by audioconference or videoconference.
Lets prospective jurors take part in jury selection by videoconference in some cases.
Expands court case management powers so court staff can handle some administrative matters for accused people without a lawyer.
Lets courts order fingerprinting at interim release or later stages when fingerprints could not be taken earlier for exceptional reasons.
Replaces the current telewarrant rules with a process for applying for and issuing many kinds of warrants, authorisations and orders by telecommunication.
summary.background: The bill also corrects minor technical errors in the Criminal Code and the Identification of Criminals Act, and includes transitional rules for how the changes apply.
